title: Hospital Operations Incident Review
scenario: The hospital operations manager needs a monthly performance pack by department. The source files contain duplicate keys, invalid chronology, negative length of stay, missing dimensions and orphan medication-order references. You must separate valid records from quarantined rows and explain how denominator choices affect KPIs.
deliverables: Department KPI table with encounter denominator
acceptance: Do not silently delete invalid records; quarantine and count them
Deduplicate using an explicit rule and retain an audit trail
Exclude invalid chronology and negative LOS from LOS calculations
Label readmission flag as supplied synthetic flag, not clinically validated readmission

title: Antihypertensive DUE Analytical Review
scenario: A clinical pharmacy team requests a descriptive review of a synthetic antihypertensive cohort. Assess follow-up SBP, change from baseline, cohort characteristics, missingness and potential confounding. Avoid causal claims and do not interpret a small synthetic cohort as real clinical evidence.
deliverables: Baseline and follow-up SBP descriptive statistics
Stratified summaries by drug class and diabetes status
Reproducible Python or R script and concise report
acceptance: Retain and report missing follow-up SBP
Flag implausible age and follow-up interval
Do not claim one drug class is superior without appropriate design and adjustment
Clearly disclose that all records and outcomes are synthetic

title: Remote Client Data Quality Escalation
scenario: A remote client reports that the medication dashboard total differs from the monthly extract. You must investigate join fan-out, missing costs, invalid quantities, blank therapeutic classes and orphan references. Prepare a clear clarification request and handoff.
deliverables: Issue register with severity and impact
Reconciliation showing raw, valid, excluded and orphan counts
SQL query with safe join grain
acceptance: Do not join raw encounter and order tables without checking cardinality
Do not treat order rows as dispensing or administration
Separate missing unit cost from zero cost
Preserve original raw inputs and create derived clean outputs
